-----
For the Petitioner : Mr. N.K. Sahani, Advocate For the State : Mr. Gautam Rakesh, App
-----
th 03/Dated: 05 June, 2025 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2.  The petitioner has moved before this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail from apprehending his arrest for the offence instituted under Sections 420/120(B) of the IPC.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in the present case and has not committed any offence as alleged in the F.I.R.

It is submitted that the petitioner has been implicated in this case on the basis of confessional statement of co-accused Riyazuddin Ansari and nothing incriminating article has been recovered with respect to the involvement of the petitioner.

It is further submitted that co-accused persons, namely, Taiyub Ansari and Afzal Ansari have already been granted anticipatory bail by the coordinate bench of this Court vide order dated 25.07.2019 passed in A.B.A. No.5015 of 2019.
He also submits that there is Bikram Ansari @ Abid Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand .

entities.text: Bikram Ansari @ Abid Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:

1
no criminal antecedent against this petitioner.

4. Learned APP opposed the prayer for bail.
5.
Having regard to the facts of the case, I am inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Bokaro in connection with Marafari P.S.
Case No.12 of 2019 with the condition that he will co-operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish Page | 1 2025:JHHC:14504 his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhaar Card with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

It is made clear that if the petitioner does not cooperate with the investigation/trial, the State would be at liberty to take appropriate action.
(Deepak Roshan, J.) Sandeep/Rahul Page | 2 Bikram Ansari @ Abid Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand . ........ Opp
